ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.1 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white high-intensity regions situated on the distal halves of both lobes; solid black low-intensity zone occupying the central fluke base and notch area; heavy stippled mottling at the transitions between white and black fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across both trailing edges; distinct deep indentation (notch) visible on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges terminating in acute, slightly upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small, roughly circular dark pixel clusters (stippling) distributed throughout the white patches, particularly dense on the inner-half of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct, parallel, dark-pixel linear marks (rake marks) oriented horizontally on the upper-outer quadrant of the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable indentation/loss of fluke material on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the tip; visible parallel rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark 'island' pigmentation motif isolated within the white field of the right lobe near the distal tip.
